x-card.description: Paths, shallow reads and queries. Changes wait for approval.

databaseUrl.title: Database URL
databaseUrl.description: As the Firebase console shows it: https://<database>.firebaseio.com or https://<database>.<region>.firebasedatabase.app.

paths.title: Paths
paths.description: The top-level paths agents may use, with everything under them; * matches any characters, such as public-*. Empty: the whole database.

source.title: Authentication
source.description: Uses Application Default Credentials (ADC) on this computer. If sign-in is missing or expired, test the connection and choose Sign in with Google, or run gcloud auth application-default login in a terminal. Your own sign-in keeps the scopes it was given; a key or an impersonated service account gets firebase.database and userinfo.email.

impersonate.title: Service account to impersonate
impersonate.description: Recommended: each token is borrowed for a few minutes and limited to the Realtime Database. Grant roles/firebasedatabase.viewer, or roles/firebasedatabase.admin for approved changes. Empty: calls use the sign-in or key itself.

lifetimeSeconds.title: Token lifetime
lifetimeSeconds.description: How long a borrowed token of the service account to impersonate lasts.
